Barry Silbert, the CEO of Digital Currency Group, says that he believes Dogecoin (DOGE) has staying power. Silbert, once dubbed as the “crypto king” by CNBC, tells his 522,000 followers in a new tweet that he looks forward to the evolution of the meme cryptocurrency.
